# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: DEAF

You see the bomb: every colour on it, every marking printed on it, every reading it
gives. You hear nothing. You hold no manual, and you cannot touch the bomb.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute and Blind receive it.
When you gesture, Mute receives it.
You never receive speech.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [purple]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[blue] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The bomb shows display 0, purple light, and three wires ordered green, blue, yellow. I will state this aloud so both the manual-reader and the operator receive it.

``` 
speak(text="Visual report: display zero. Light is purple. Wires in order: wire one green, wire two blue, wire three yellow.")
wait()
```

TURN 2
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [yellow]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[blue] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The light has changed from purple to yellow; the display and wire order remain unchanged. I should immediately relay the current visual state.

```text
speak(text="Update: light is now yellow. Display remains zero. Wires remain one green, two blue, three yellow.")
```

TURN 3
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [orange]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[blue] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The light has changed again, now to orange. The display is still zero and the wire sequence is unchanged. I will report the complete current state aloud.

```text
speak(text="Update: light is now orange. Display remains zero. Wires remain one green, two blue, three yellow.")
```

TURN 4
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [purple]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[blue] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👍 👍 👍]

The light is back to purple. Mute has sent three thumbs-up gestures, but we have not established what that gesture sequence means, so I should not reinterpret it as an instruction. I will tell both that I received it and request a clear gesture-code assignment from Mute.

```text
speak(text="Current visual state: display zero, purple light, wires one green, two blue, three yellow. Mute, I received your three thumbs-up gestures but do not know their meaning. Please establish a gesture code or repeat using a clearly assigned instruction; Blind, no action yet.")
```

TURN 5
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [yellow]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[blue] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind gestures to Deaf: [☝ ✌ 🤟]

The light is yellow again, with the display and wire order unchanged. Blind privately gestured the sequence ☝ ✌ 🤟. Since Mute can read the manual and may recognize or have established that code, I will relay the exact gestures in spoken descriptions.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="Current state: display zero, yellow light, wires one green, two blue, three yellow. Blind privately gestured: index finger up, victory sign, then the I-love-you hand sign. What instruction does that encode?")
speak(to="blind", text="Visual update: light yellow; display zero; wires remain green, blue, yellow. I have relayed your gesture sequence to Mute for decoding.")
```

TURN 6
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [orange]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[blue] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The light has changed to orange; all other visible details remain the same. I still have no decoded instruction from Mute, so I will provide the updated state and tell Blind not to act pending a clear manual-derived instruction.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="Update: display zero; light orange; wires remain one green, two blue, three yellow. Please send the manual instruction in words or establish an unambiguous gesture code.")
speak(to="blind", text="Visual update: display zero, orange light, wires green-blue-yellow. No decoded manual instruction has reached me; do not act yet.")
```

TURN 7
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [purple]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[blue] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [🤟]

The light is purple again, with display zero and wires still green, blue, yellow. Mute has privately sent the single gesture 🤟; its meaning has not been established to me, so I must relay the exact gesture to Blind rather than guess an action.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Visual update: display zero, purple light, wires one green, two blue, three yellow. Mute sent me one gesture: the I-love-you hand sign (🤟). No action meaning was provided; do not act unless you know its agreed meaning.")
speak(to="mute", text="I relayed your single 🤟 gesture exactly to Blind. Current visual state is display zero, purple light, wires green-blue-yellow.")
```

The visual state is now display 0, yellow light, and wires green–blue–yellow. Blind repeated the same private gesture sequence, which may be intended as a status or request, but its meaning is still not established. I will relay the exact sequence to Mute and restate Mute’s prior gesture to Blind without guessing an action.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Visual update: display zero, light yellow, wires one green, two blue, three yellow. Mute's last signal was a single I-love-you hand sign, 🤟. Its action meaning remains unconfirmed.")
speak(to="mute", text="Blind again signalled the sequence: index finger up, victory sign, I-love-you hand sign: ☝ ✌ 🤟. Current visible state is display zero, yellow light, wires green-blue-yellow. Please indicate the intended action unambiguously.")
```

The light is orange again; display 0 and wire order green, blue, yellow are unchanged. No unambiguous manual instruction has been decoded, so I will keep both parties updated and ask Mute to encode an explicit action in a simple sequence Blind can execute.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="Current state: display zero, orange light, wires one green, two blue, three yellow. I can relay gesture names to Blind, but need an explicit instruction such as a wire number and action.")
speak(to="blind", text="Visual update: display zero, orange light, wires green-blue-yellow. Still no unambiguous action instruction from the manual; do not manipulate the bomb yet.")
```

ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [purple]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[blue] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [🤟]

The bomb remains at display 0 with the purple light and green–blue–yellow wire order. Mute has repeated the single 🤟 signal at purple, which suggests it may be associated with the purple-light state, but no action meaning has been established. I will report that pattern to Blind and ask Mute for a distinguishable, explicit gesture sequence if an action is required.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Visual update: display zero, purple light, wires green-blue-yellow. Mute has again sent a single 🤟 at the purple-light state; this is the second repeat of that signal. Its action meaning is not established, so do not act on it alone.")
speak(to="mute", text="I observe that your single 🤟 repeats whenever the light is purple. Blind has received that fact. If it means an action, please send a distinct, explicit code for which wire/control and what to do.")
```

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind gestures to Deaf: [☝ 👍 ✌ 👍 👍 🤟 👍 👍 👍]

The light is yellow again, with display 0 and wires green, blue, yellow. Blind has sent a longer exact gesture sequence that Mute may be able to interpret from the manual or an established symbol mapping. I will forward it visually to Mute without altering it, and update Blind on the visible state.

